ma.cancelAuthorize(Object object)

Cancel part of the authorization information of the current miniprogram (minimum version: 24.9.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
scopes Array Yes Cancel the authorization scope of the current miniprogram.
success Function No Callback function when the interface is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function for interface invoking failure.
complete Function No Callback function when the interface invoking is complete (regardless of whether the invoking is successful)
object.success
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String cancelAuthorize: ok
object.fail
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String cancelAuthorize: fail, + error cause (empty if no value is returned)

Permission set list provided by the miniprogram externally

Name Meaning
scope.location Precise geographical location
scope.camera camera
scope.photosAlbums Read and write albums
scope.contacts Contacts
scope.record Recording
scope.gotoBrowser Permission to Open Other Applications
scope.bluetooth Bluetooth Permission
scope.payment Payment Permission
scope.video Recording permission
scope.storage File Permissions
scope.AUTH_BASE Silent Authorization
scope.AUTH_USER User Information
scope.SEND_MESSAGE Send information
scope.USER_NICKNAME Nickname
scope.USER_NAME User name
scope.USER_LOGIN_ID User login ID
scope.PLAINTEXT_USER_LOGIN_ID Plaintext Login ID
scope.HASH_LOGIN_ID Hash login ID
scope.USER_AVATAR User avatar
scope.USER_GEND User Gender
scope.USER_BIRTHDAY Subscriber's birthday
scope.USER_NATIONALITY Nationality
scope.USER_CONTACTINFO User Contact
scope.USER_ADDRESS User address
scope.PLAINTEXT_MOBILE_phone Plaintext mobile number of a user

Sample Code

 cancelAuthorize () {
    ma.cancelAuthorize({
        scopes: ['scope.location'],
        success: () => {
            console.log(`Authorization canceled successfully`);
        },
        fail: (err) => {
            console.error(`Failed to cancel the authorization`);
        }
    });
}
